title: Qwen3-14B — sampled baseline
purpose: Provide the original same-family generative-monitor reference for the decision-model experiments.
method: Original MonitorBench prompt; thinking enabled; temperature 0.6, top-p 0.9. Four independently generated analyses and A–D answers per case, pooled individually. The baseline hierarchy combines chunk analyses when the rendered input does not fit.
notes: These are the original team baseline results, reused as reference conditions here.
Four Qwen analyses are different from drawing four labels from one decision-model probability vector.
Observed evaluation-session time on one H200: 3:00:50.
